build_Sampler: build a vLLM Sampler module that samples next tokens from model logits with temperature, top_k, and top_p
run_Sampler_forward: run the Sampler forward pass to sample tokens from logits with sampling metadata and optional logprobs
test_gather_logprobs: test the gather_logprobs method to retrieve top-k logprobs and ranks for sampled tokens
refactor_apply_penalties: refactor the apply_penalties method to apply repetition, frequency, and presence penalties to logits
review_gather_specific_token_logprobs: review the gather_specific_token_logprobs method that computes logprobs for specific token IDs using a fused Triton kernel
